reserveReview.rationale: At Rootstock block 9219109 (2026-09-07T12:47:43Z), canonical MoC custody and MoCState collateralRbtcInSystem()/rbtcInSystem() both report 273.257760878423658725 rBTC. DOC supply is 2,825,549.027393543076353703, and the valid protocol BTC oracle reports $79,465.80, giving 7.685106987665169x coverage. The verified deployed MoCState implementation returns accounted rBTC as total collateral because X2 leveraged positions are disabled; the X2 share count is zero. globalLockedBitcoin() reserves 35.556793329879559211 rBTC for senior DOC claims and getRbtcRemainder() reports 237.700967548544099514 rBTC of residual risk capital. BPRO bears the residual Bitcoin exposure rather than a second fixed-dollar liability; the full accounted collateral is therefore the correct system coverage numerator, not a DOC-only wallet and not raw unaccounted donations. The live adapter pins reviewed implementation identities, reconciles state DOC supply against the canonical token, checks oracle validity and accounting at one block, caps admitted backing at the actual custody balance, and degrades custody deficits, undercoverage, pause or liquidation.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Canonical Rootstock MoCState accounted rBTC, DOC supply and protocol-valid BTC oracle at one block; custody balance and senior DOC/junior BPRO accounting reconciled
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The only backing asset class is rBTC. Protocol oracle valuation, Rootstock peg/custody and upgrade risks remain; BPRO residual risk capital is shared system collateral, not a separately guaranteed DOC reserve. Ethereum and Arbitrum DOC representations are not additional collateral or additional canonical DOC liabilities.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: All collateral sits in the single MoC system contract, an upgradeable proxy, so contract-admin action is the operative custody risk rather than a custodian. The 2026-08-23 Rootstock read confirms the current balance at the MoC address; no legal segregation, bankruptcy-remoteness, or rehypothecation terms exist for contract custody. Public code audits in the official repository date to 2019.
